sentences.text:
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Shashidhar Pandey, learned AGA for State respondents.
2.

The instant writ petition has been preferred for a direction to respondent no. 2 to make fair,
impartial and proper investigation of the Case Crime No. 0090 of 2024 under Sections 147, 323,
308, 392, 427, 452, 506, 376, 411 IPC, P.S. Barra, Distt. Kaushambi and arrest respondent nos. 3 to 10.

sentences.text:
Learned AGA, on the instructions, states that in the present matter after investigation,
charge-sheet no. 129 of 2024 dated 28.5.2024 has been forwarded to the competent court and as such the cause of filing the writ petition no more survives.
4. Considering the categorical statement of learned AGA, we are not inclined to proceed further in the matter.
The writ petition stands disposed of accordingly.
